"""Verify immutable architecture readiness,frozen sources and native comparators."""
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v161-harmonic-context-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v161-harmonic-context-preparation-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
p=read(index);assert len(p['copies'])==11 and p['source_texts']==45
for item in p['copies'].values():
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
bundle=read(p['sources']['path']);assert ref(p['sources']['path'])==p['sources']
assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==45 and len(bundle['unchanged_prior_neural_hashes'])==87
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for path,h in bundle['unchanged_prior_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(path).name)['sha256']==h
assert len(list((Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py')))==88
assert ref(bundle['new_module']['path'])==bundle['new_module']
ready=read(root/'readiness-audit-v1.json');assert ready['finite_Adam_states_at10']==91
assert ready['all91_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients']
assert ready['exact_V160_control_prefix_rows']==40
import json
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(ready['training_prefix']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
old=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace'];assert len(rows)==40
for row,before in zip(rows,old[:40],strict=True):
    assert row['step']==before['step'] and row['batch']==before['batch'] and row['domain']==before['domain']
    assert row['arms']['paired-control']==before['arms']['paired-response']
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json');assert len(design['observations'])==822
assert len(design['context_removal']['case_ids'])==12 and design['context_removal']['new_head_calls']==48
arrays=0
for binding in post['retained_native_collections'].values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    c=read(binding['path']);assert c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['RNG_unchanged']
    for row,case in zip(c['observations'],design['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction'];arrays+=1
assert arrays==4110
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
    'docs/harmonic-frequency-context.md','diary/2026-11-07-04-50-07-v161-harmonic-context.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    path=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(),(path,link);links+=1
save(output,{'status':'pass-immutable-readiness-and-fixed-comparators','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':11,'source_texts':45,'unchanged_prior_neural_hashes':87,
    'new_neural_modules':1,'actual_CPU_tests':139,'restored_smoke_finite_Adam_states':91,
    'exact_V160_control_prefix_rows':40,'retained_prediction_arrays_checked':arrays,
    'planned_total_scientific_head_calls':5412,'fixed_context_removal_inputs':12,
    'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},'document_links_checked':links,
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'scope':'Actual readiness and original live snapshot only;trained quality and actual final native viewing remain pending.'})
print('PASS11 receipts,45 source texts,87 unchanged prior modules/one new,40 exact control rows,4110 retained arrays and',links,'links')
